metadata.description: Local development marketplace for cccollab. Loads the plugin from ../plugin so changes to plugin.json / .mcp.json / skills are picked up immediately. The MCP command runs the repo's bin/cccollab (which prefers src/ + tsx over dist/); test/start.sh prepends the repo's bin/ to PATH for the test session so the harness exercises local source without npm link clobbering the global @kollaborativeai/cccollab install.

plugins.name: cccollab
plugins.description: Real-time collaboration between Claude Code sessions via threaded topics (local dev build)
